{"metadata":{"description":"A pluginized microkernel architecture for building, orchestrating, and extending multi-agent systems in DeepSeek Harness.","id":"gh:1367407437","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-flow","slug":"rootkiller6788/dsh-flow","topics":["agent-teams","agentic-workflow","ai-agents","dsh","dsh-plugin","multi-agent","workflow"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A pluginized microkernel architecture for building, orchestrating, and extending multi-agent systems"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" in DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-flow"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 · **English**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"What stalls long or complex work is usually not "not enough tools". It is that the executor cannot b"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"e swapped, the state has no source of truth, and the boundaries have no assertions — a task that has"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" run for hours crashes once and cannot say how far it got; changing how work is executed means chang"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ing the core, and so does adding a kind of team source."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"dsh-flow solves all three at the level of **kernel shape**: `rules/` is a pure core (no IO, no `ctx`"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"), execution and sources are **declared seams**, and `kernel.js` is the single composition root that"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" decides which implementation this deployment attaches."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It and dsh-agent-teams are **two kernel shapes**: the same capability surface, the opposite internal"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" shape. That opposition is where this document starts."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"= 22.19.0">"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Two kernel shapes"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"In the host's own words, the difference is **whether a plugin divides its own internals into service"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"s**. The host frames this as "everything is a plugin" and "Plugins, not loop changes", which in code"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" comes down to the `core` / `seam` split:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Usual phrasing | The host's own terms | The evidence |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| **microkernel** | Keep `core` as small as possible and hang every capability off a **declared seam"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"**; new behaviour goes on an extension point rather than into `core` | dsh-flow: a `rules/` pure cor"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"e (no IO, no `ctx`) + three services + one composition root |
| **monolithic kernel** | No seam; the"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" capabilities all live inside `core` | dsh-agent-teams: `src/` is one flat plane (17 TS modules + 13"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" under `client/`), importing each other freely, with no mechanism asserting module boundaries |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"A seam comprises three roles — **Service Definition / Provider / Consumer** — and is only complete w"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ith all three. In dsh-flow they line up plainly: `runner/interface.js` is the definition, `manual.js"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"` and `subagents.js` are the two Providers, and `tools/` is the Consumer."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### What it is like to use"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| | dsh-flow | dsh-agent-teams |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Install | Clone it and it runs, **nothing to install** | Pulls a whole dependency tree (24 peers, "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"including React 18) |
| Host upgrade | Declares no host version; probes capabilities at runtime and "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"takes a fallback branch when it cannot | Pins 4 host versions in its peers; outside those it will no"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"t work |
| Change one canvas line | Save → **refresh the page** (0 builds, 0 restarts) | Rebuild the"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" client bundle → **restart the host** |
| Stop execution, keep the view | `runner: manual` — look an"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"d edit, nothing runs | No equivalent switch |
| How a task's attempts went | Click a task row for th"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"e **attempt timeline**: how each attempt ended, which was rolled back | A monotonic attempt counter "},{"id":"p17s8","text":"that cannot say how any one ended |
| Unreadable lines | Go into the **import report**, listed with "},{"id":"p17s9","text":"**line numbers** on the canvas | — |
| Teams that cannot reach the canvas | Counted in the toolbar; "},{"id":"p17s10","text":"they do not vanish silently | — |
| Approving a plan | Edit and approve directly on the canvas, thro"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"ugh the same validation `flow_edit_plan` / `flow_approve` use | Panel editing |
| The canvas | Sessi"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"on timeline and team hierarchy **in one figure** (the team nests under the requirement turns) | A te"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"am tree panel |
| Uninstalling the other plugin | Everything keeps working — there was never a secon"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"|
| Uninstalling the other plugin | Everything keeps working — there was never a second record | — |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"What you can "feel" in the table above all comes from the architecture: **a change takes effect on r"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"efresh** because canvas modules are served over HTTP individually (`src/**` invalidated by mtime + E"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"Tag revalidation), with no bundle step; **`runner: manual` exists** because execution is a seam, fix"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ed at composition time; and **uninstalling the other plugin changes nothing** because team records a"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"re this plugin's own append-only log, with the other plugin only an entry in the source registry. Ch"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"anging `client.js` (the tab registration layer) still requires a host restart on both sides — that l"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"ayer really does go into the host's client bundle."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Why there is no "N times faster" here"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"A cross-implementation performance comparison requires **both sides to run on this machine**. dsh-ag"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ent-teams' full pipeline does not: it has no `node_modules` and no `lib/` (its published artifact), "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"and its `snapshot.ts` imports host runtime packages directly (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, `@deepseek-ai/"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"dsh-agent`). Replacing those with stubs and then timing measures the stubs, not it. Its state-readin"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"g layer (`src/state.ts`) depends only on Node builtins and could in principle run directly under Nod"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"e 24, but that is another repository's code, and running it needs your explicit consent."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"So any "N times faster" in this repository would be invented. What can be given is the kind of diffe"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"rence above — **confirmable without running anything** — plus my own reproducible measurements."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## What is on the canvas"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"One page, one engine, one figure. Nodes come in two kinds:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Node | What it draws | Data source |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| **Session turn card** | One round of conversation (question + answer), wired into a branch tree by"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" DSH's native fork relation; follow-up / branch / archive from here. **Agent event turns** — member "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"relays, subagent notices — render as a derived label (`论文手 → 队长`), never as raw protocol text | The "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"host's `sessions` + `workspaces` services, projected to disk at `flow/workspaces.json` |
| **Team re"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"gion** | Under the team's title bar, nested **member sub-regions**: one cell per member, holding the"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"ir task chips (wired by dependency depth) and speech cards (laid out in time order). Assignment is e"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"xpressed by containment, dependency by arrows, dialogue flow by the turn chain crossing regions | Te"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"am data **lives in dsh-flow's own storage** (`<stateDir>/<teamId>/events.jsonl`); when the deploymen"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"t has a `.agent-teams/`, it is listed alongside as a **read-only source** |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"One package, zero runtime dependencies, no build. **The source is the artifact**: `files` lists `.js"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"`, not `lib/` — clone it and it runs, with no "compile first" step."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The host's design philosophy is everything is a plugin, and it classifies services as `core` / `seam"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"` / `bundle`. dsh-flow divides itself the same way: **one pure core, two seams, one composition root"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" `bundle`. dsh-flow divides itself the same way: **one pure core, two seams, one composition root**."}],"truncated":true}
